course.title: L10 Yesterday, Tomorrow, and Directions
course.description: 用昨天、明天、程度副词和东西南北说明过去、计划和地图方向。 场景：学员看一张小镇地图，说昨天怎么来、明天去哪，以及目标地点在东西南北哪个方向。 目标词：almost, even, quite, very, tomorrow, yesterday, north, south, east, west。核心句型：yesterday I ... / tomorrow I will ... / north/south/east/west of ... / almost ... / even ... / quite ... / very ...。
